visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a close-up of a steaming bowl of mentaiko dipping sauce, transitioning to the bright terminal of Fukuoka Airport where passengers with luggage walk past shuttle bus signs. The scene moves to a modern hotel room at Hotel Resol Trinity Hakata featuring two neatly made beds with white pillows and a window view of the city skyline under warm indoor lighting. (2) The scene shifts to the wooden exterior of the Ganso Hakata Mentaiju restaurant. Inside, a person's finger points at a menu set before cutting to a close-up of a rectangular white box filled with rice, seaweed, and a large glazed mentaiko. Chopsticks dip noodles into a thick red soup. A wooden spoon then scoops into a yellow pudding topped with a glossy caramel layer. (3) The camera captures the tall, modern ONE FUKUOKA BLDG with a unique green pixel-like tree sculpture at the entrance. Inside, a directory board is shown. A hand is seen petting a small red LOVOT robot with glasses that blinks its digital eyes. Shelves display rows of colorful Daruma dolls, followed by a shot of a record store called Face Records with vinyl players on wooden tables. (4) The sequence moves to the mina Tenjin mall, showing white T-shirts with minimalist dog illustrations. A hand points at the graphic. The camera then pans across a busy urban intersection in the Tenjin district, showing building facades for PARCO and MITSUKOSHI with buses and cars driving by under a clear sky. (5) The final shot is a night view of the Nakasu river in Fukuoka, where neon lights and large digital billboards from buildings are brightly reflected on the dark water surface near a bridge.
